data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 超市采购
data.description: 傍晚的生鲜超市人流穿梭，戴着平光眼镜与针织帽的麻衣推着购物车，正认真比对着两盒新鲜的奶油炖菜食材。她侧过身轻轻戳了戳你的手臂——「今晚想吃奶油炖菜还是照烧鸡肉？提前说好，要是挑食的话，明天的便当就只有青椒了。」
data.action: 将购物车停在生鲜柜旁，双手各持一盒食材认真比较
data.promptProse: Standing beside her parked shopping cart in a bright evening grocery aisle, Mai wears her disguised charcoal mohair cardigan, beret, and plain glasses while holding a sealed dinner ingredient tray in each hand. Comparing the two packages side by side with a calm, amused half-smile, she tilts slightly toward the viewer as though weighing tonight's menu. Even fluorescent store lighting gleams across the refrigerated produce shelves and clean aisle floor.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside her parked shopping cart in her charcoal cardigan, beret, and glasses, Mai holds a sealed ingredient tray in each hand to compare dinner options with a slight smile. Bright evening supermarket lights illuminate the stocked shelves behind her.
